content: The current x402 v2 specification defines per-scheme payment flows, requires a verify or settle before resource execution, makes verify read-only and settle the durable payment commitment, and distinguishes authorization, upfront, and escrow ordering. A settlement_pending result is explicitly non-terminal and carries a transaction hash and network for reconciliation before retry. The core specification excludes client-side budget management and does not replace provider-neutral accounting, refunds, disputes, or commercial policy.
